subject: Artifact staging access and telemetry routing for SIG evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Becker <alyssa@halideinc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Artifact staging access and telemetry routing for SIG evaluation

Hi Alyssa / Halide security team,

Thanks again for agreeing to run through the SIG/CAIQ evidence set with us next week. A couple logistical asks so we can prepare the evidence handoff and telemetry samples: 

- Can you confirm a 2-hour dry-run window when we can request log snapshots and a short live-export session (preferably PST-friendly windows)?
- For artifact transfer: do you prefer SFTP or temporary cloud share (S3 pre-signed links)? If SFTP, please share a host, user, and the IP allowlist for our upload.
- For telemetry: which systems are easiest to export (Splunk, Syslog, CloudWatch)? If Splunk, will you be able to export a 48-hour rolling window including indexed fields for request IDs?

Attached: artifact-inventory.xlsx (stub) with a proposed list of artifacts we typically request. I can pare it down based on what you can provide.

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (security intake), Kimberly Park (controls/evidence owner), and David Kim (logging samples). Please add any Halide engineers you want on the call — Marco (cc'd) might be a good technical point.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 2027-02-23 10:00-12:00
- Wed 2027-02-24 13:00-15:00
- Thu 2027-02-25 09:00-11:00

Let me know what works and whether you have tool-specific constraints. Once we lock a slot I'll share a short runbook and the Drive folder for artifact uploads.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Security Enablement | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Alyssa Becker <alyssa@halideinc.com>
To: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@halideinc.com>, Halide Security Team <security@halideinc.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact staging access and telemetry routing for SIG evaluation

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can do S3 pre-signed uploads for the bulk artifacts and a short Splunk export for telemetry. Marco will be the tech lead on our side and can provide the export job.

Quick answers:
- Preferred window: Wed 2027-02-24 13:00-15:00 PST works best for Halide.
- Artifact upload: S3 pre-signed links are easiest. I can send a folder-level link with 48-hour expiry.
- Telemetry: we can export a 72-hour Splunk slice (index=prod) that includes request_id and user_agent. We can also provide a filtered syslog sample if you need packet-level context.

I've looped in Marco — Marco, can you confirm the Splunk export format (CSV vs JSON) and whether there are any PII redaction steps we should do beforehand?

Thanks,
Alyssa Becker
Head of Product Security | Halide Inc
alyssa@halideinc.com

Great — Wed 2027-02-24 13:00-15:00 PST locked. I'll create a short runbook and a Drive folder; linking below.

Action items for Halide before the call:
- Share S3 pre-signed folder link (48 hour expiry) and confirm the maximum single-file size you accept.
- Marco: confirm Splunk export format (CSV preferred for our ingest scripts) and whether you will remove any obvious PII fields. If you can provide JSON with event timestamps in ISO8601 that's also fine.
- Please identify a single contact (name + mobile) for emergency access during the dry-run.

From our side:
- Kimberly will own the CAIQ control mapping and will provide the expected artifact filenames (see expected-artifacts-checklist.pdf attached).
- David will run a sample ingestion on a dev Splunk instance and send back a small sample file (sig-telemetry-sample.txt) to verify field mappings.

Drive folder (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_eXAMPLE
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/22933/company/halide-inc (HS-22933)

I'll also add a short run-of-show in the calendar invite and include instructions for the S3 upload. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Becker <alyssa@halideinc.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@halideinc.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact staging access and telemetry routing for SIG evaluation — notes and next steps

Quick post-call notes and owners (notes from the dry-run today):

Summary:
- Halide provided S3 pre-signed folder and a 72-hour Splunk export (CSV). Export included request_id, timestamp, status_code, path, and user_agent.
- Halide will not perform PII redaction prior to export but confirmed the dataset contains tokenized user IDs only (no raw PII).
- File sizes: largest exported file ~1.2GB; Halide confirmed pre-signed link supports multipart upload.

Action items:
1) Priyom — collect the S3 folder link from Alyssa and validate expiry window in the Drive runbook (due 2027-02-21 11:00 PST).
2) David — run ingestion test on dev Splunk with sig-telemetry-sample.txt and report back whether request_id maps to our trace_id (due 2027-02-22 EOD).
3) Marco (Halide) — provide the Splunk export CSV schema and a short README about the fields (due 2027-02-22).
4) Kimberly — map exported fields to CAIQ control IDs and list any missing artifacts in a short gap table (due 2027-02-23).

Risks / follow-ups:
- If the exported fields don't include session-cookie or ip_anon fields we may need a second export for correlation.
- For items over 2GB, Halide suggested staging via an S3 manifest; Priyom to confirm if we need longer retention on the pre-signed link.

I'll drop these into the HubSpot ticket (HS-22933) and attach the gap table when ready.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Controls & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
